scripts.text:
[Yotang]
There lives a fairy on the 3rd floor of Kunlun.
She is so famous for her beauty
that she even got a fan club.
scripts.translation:
[约唐]
昆仑的三楼住着一位妖精。
她以美貌闻名，
甚至拥有自己的粉丝俱乐部。

scripts.text:
[Yotang]
Of course, I am the master of the fan club.
How about joining the fairy fan club?
scripts.translation:
[约唐]
当然，我就是这个粉丝俱乐部的主席。
要不要加入妖精粉丝俱乐部呢？

scripts.text: I'm not that interested!!
scripts.translation: 我一点兴趣都没有！！

scripts.text: I'll join it right away!!
scripts.translation: 我马上加入！！

scripts.text:
[Yotang]
What! I'm going to tell on you!
scripts.translation:
[约唐]
什么！我要去告发你！

scripts.text:
[Yotang]
Oh, aren't those....!
the materials for the Flower of Fairy?
Have we met before? You already know everything...
scripts.translation:
[约唐]
哦，那不是....！
制作妖精之花的材料吗？
我们以前见过？你什么都知道...

scripts.text:
[Yotang]
Anyway, do you want me to make the Flower of Fairy?
scripts.translation:
[约唐]
总之，你想让我制作妖精之花吗？

scripts.text:
[Yotang]
^FF0000Please be aware that
the refinement on the materials will all disappear
if you once combine those.^000000
scripts.translation:
[约唐]
^FF0000请注意，
一旦合成，材料上的精炼属性将会全部消失。^000000

scripts.text: No, next time.
scripts.translation: 不，下次再说。

scripts.text: Make it right now!!
scripts.translation: 现在就做！！

scripts.text:
[Yotang]
You'll regret it!
scripts.translation:
[约唐]
你会后悔的！

scripts.text:
[Yotang]
You're speedy!
You deserve to be a master of the fanclub for the next term.
scripts.translation:
[约唐]
动作真快！
你完全有资格担任下一届粉丝俱乐部的主席。

scripts.text: Combining... ... ...

[Yotang]
Here, the Flower of Fairy.
scripts.translation:
[约唐]
给你，妖精之花。

scripts.text:
[Yotang]
See you on the fan meeting!
scripts.translation:
[约唐]
粉丝见面会上见！

scripts.text:
[Yotang]
Huh? You don't have enough
materials for it..
Aren't you wearing Bandana?
Check it out!
scripts.translation:
[约唐]
咦？你的材料不够啊..
难道你没戴方头巾？
检查一下！

scripts.text:
[Yotang]
Bring me all the materials,
if you want to get the Flower of Fairy.
scripts.translation:
[约唐]
如果你想获得妖精之花，
就把所有材料都带给我。

scripts.text:
[Yotang]
If you bring me ^0000FF100 Transparent Celestial Robes, 100 Soft Silk Cloth,
1 Wedding Bouquet, 1 Violet Dyestuffs
and ^0000FF1 Bandana^000000 which you can find at a store,
I will make you a ^0000FFFlower of Fairy^000000.
scripts.translation:
[约唐]
如果你给我^0000FF100件害羞之服、100件柔软的绸缎布、
1束捧花、1份紫色染料
以及^0000FF1件方头巾^000000（可以在商店买到），
我就为你制作一朵^0000FF妖精之花^000000。

scripts.text:
[Yotang]
You can meet the fairy soon
for there will be a fan meeting
in the near future.
The Flower of Fairy is necessary
for joining the fan meeting. Everyone wears it.
scripts.translation:
[约唐]
很快就能见到妖精了，
因为近期将举行粉丝见面会。
参加粉丝见面会需要妖精之花。大家都戴着它。

scripts.text:
[Yotang]
If you bring me some materials
I'll make it for you.
scripts.translation:
[约唐]
如果你给我一些材料，
我就为你制作。

scripts.text:
[Yotang]
I need ^0000FF100 Transparent Celestial Robes, 100 Soft Silk Cloth,
1 Wedding Bouquet, 1 Violet Dyestuffs
and ^0000FF1 Bandana^000000 which you can find at a store,
scripts.translation:
[约唐]
我需要^0000FF100件害羞之服、100件柔软的绸缎布、
1束捧花、1份紫色染料
以及^0000FF1件方头巾^000000（可以在商店买到），

scripts.text:
[Yotang]
If you bring me ^0000FF100 Transparent Celestial Robes, 100 Soft Silk Cloth,
1 Wedding Bouquet, 1 Violet Dyestuffs
and ^0000FF1 Bandana^000000 which you can find at a store,
I will make you a ^0000FFFlower of Fairy^000000.
scripts.translation:
[约唐]
如果你给我^0000FF100件害羞之服、100件柔软的绸缎布、
1束捧花、1份紫色染料
以及^0000FF1件方头巾^000000（可以在商店买到），
我就为你制作一朵^0000FF妖精之花^000000。

scripts.text:
[Yotang]
^FF0000Please be aware that
the refinement on the materials will all disappear
if you once combine those.^000000
scripts.translation:
[约唐]
^FF0000请注意，
一旦合成，材料上的精炼属性将会全部消失。^000000

scripts.text: I won't do it.
scripts.translation: 我不做了。

scripts.text: Here, I have the materials!
scripts.translation: 这里，我有材料！

scripts.text:
[Yotang]
You'll regret it!
scripts.translation:
[约唐]
你会后悔的！

scripts.text:
[Yotang]
Huh? Are you kidding me?
scripts.translation:
[约唐]
咦？你在开玩笑吗？

scripts.text:
[Yotang]
I need ^0000FF100 Transparent Celestial Robes, 100 Soft Silk Cloth,
1 Wedding Bouquet, 1 Violet Dyestuffs
and ^0000FF1 Bandana^000000 which you can find at a store
to make a ^0000FFFlower of Fairy^000000.
scripts.translation:
[约唐]
我需要^0000FF100件害羞之服、100件柔软的绸缎布、
1束捧花、1份紫色染料
以及^0000FF1件方头巾^000000（可以在商店买到），
才能制作一朵^0000FF妖精之花^000000。

scripts.text:
[Yotang]
Your bag is too heavy, isn't it?
Come to me again
after emptying your bag.
scripts.translation:
[约唐]
你的背包太重了吧？
清空背包后再来找我。

scripts.text:
- Wait !! -
- You have too many items, so it's -
- impossible to have more. -
- Come to me again -
- after emptying some of it. -
scripts.translation:
- 等等！！ -
- 你的物品太多了，所以 -
- 不可能再装更多了。 -
- 清空一些物品后 -
- 再来找我。 -

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Hey... you wanna fight?!
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
嘿...你想打架吗？！

scripts.text: He seems to be drunken badly. What should I do?
scripts.translation: 他好像醉得很厉害。我该怎么办？

scripts.text: Just ignore him.
scripts.translation: 无视他

scripts.text: Fight!
scripts.translation: 战斗！

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Why are you ignoring me?
Are you afraid of me?
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
你为什么无视我？
你怕我吗？

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
What... you're weaker than me.
Go and reach the higher level!
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
什...么...你比我弱。
去提升等级吧！

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Hold! I need some armor to wear.
That's it, Necktie, Necktie...
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
等等！我需要穿件盔甲。
对了，领带，领带...

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Once I wear the Necktie on my head,
I will be no match for you!
You must be nervous.
Hmm! Where is the Necktie?
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
一旦我把领带戴在头上，
你就不是我的对手了！
你一定很紧张吧。
嗯！领带在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Oh, you're having the materials for Necktie! give them to me!!
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
哦，你身上有领带的材料！快给我！！

scripts.text: No way!
scripts.translation: 绝对不行！

scripts.text: Here you are.
scripts.translation: 给你。

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Ohh, you are scared!
I won again!!
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
哦，你吓坏了！
我又赢了！！

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Great, wait for a moment!
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
很好，等一下！

scripts.text: Combining... ch...ch... ...

[Drunken Man]
Drunk...drunk.... Zzzzz...

He zonked out as soon as
he finished it.
Let's just take the Necktie.
scripts.translation:
他刚做完就睡着了。
把领带拿走吧。

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Huh? Where are all the materials gone?
Did you take it back that you're so afraid of me?
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
咦？材料都不见了？
难道你怕我，把它们拿走了？

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Hey, go and get
^FF00001 Cobaltblue Dyestuff, 30 Oil Papers, 100 Fabrics, 20 Spools^000000!
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
去给我弄来
^FF00001个钴蓝染料、30张油纸、100块布料、20个线轴^000000！

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
I will beat you off wearing the legendary Necktie!
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
我要戴着那条传说中的领带，把你揍飞！

scripts.text: I won't.
scripts.translation: 我不写

scripts.text: Let's go and get them.
scripts.translation: 去收集材料

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Are you dropping out?
Did I win again?
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
你要放弃吗？
我又赢了吧？

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
I'm telling you once more
for you might forget it, dumbhead!
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
我再告诉你一次，
免得你这笨蛋忘了！

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
^FF00001 Cobaltblue Dyestuff, 30 Oil Papers, 100 Fabrics, 20 Spools^000000!
Hurry! I'll be futzing around with others.
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
^FF00001个钴蓝染料、30张油纸、100块布料、20个线轴^000000！
快点！我还要陪别人玩呢。

scripts.text:
Necktie is heavier than I thought.
Seems like the very legendary Necktie.
scripts.translation:
这条领带比我想象中要重。
看来是传说中的领带。

scripts.text:
- Wait !! -
- You have too many items, so it's -
- impossible to have more. -
- Come to me again -
- after emptying some of it. -
scripts.translation:
- 等等！！ -
- 你的物品太多了，所以 -
- 不可能再装更多了。 -
- 清空一些物品后 -
- 再来找我。 -

scripts.text:
[Hat Girl]
Isn't the unique hat much better
than the common hairbands?
scripts.translation:
[戴帽子的女孩]
独特的帽子不是比普通的发带更好看吗？

scripts.text: I still prefer hairbands!
scripts.translation: 我还是喜欢发带！

scripts.text: Hat is the best!
scripts.translation: 帽子才是最好的！

scripts.text:
[Hat Girl]
Wear your boring hairband for the whole lifetime!
scripts.translation:
[戴帽子的女孩]
那你就戴着那无聊的发带过一辈子吧！

scripts.text:
[Hat Girl]
You have a good sense!
I thought I would make
a trendy hat.
scripts.translation:
[戴帽子的女孩]
你的眼光真不错！
我想做一顶时尚的帽子。

scripts.text:
[Hat Girl]
I will give you an honor,
to be a fashion superstar,
if you bring me the materials for it.
scripts.translation:
[戴帽子的女孩]
如果你能给我材料，
我就给你个荣誉，
让你成为时尚巨星。

scripts.text:
[Hat Girl]
Oh! you're bringing ^0000FFthe materials for Hair Brush^000000.
Do you want me to make it now?
scripts.translation:
[戴帽子的女孩]
哦！你带来了^0000FF制作红发梳的材料^000000。
你想让我现在做吗？

scripts.text: I think the hairband is better...
scripts.translation: 我觉得发带更好...

scripts.text: Yes, please make it!
scripts.translation: 是的，请做吧！

scripts.text:
[Hat Girl]
Wear your boring hairband for the whole lifetime!
scripts.translation:
[戴帽子的女孩]
那你就戴着那无聊的发带过一辈子吧！

scripts.text:
[Hat Girl]
Okay, I'll do it right away!
scripts.translation:
[戴帽子的女孩]
好的，我马上做！

scripts.text: Ch ch ch... combining...ch ch.

[Hat Girl]
Here, it's done!
Now you're the fashionista!
scripts.translation:
[戴帽子的女孩]
好了，完成了！
现在你就是时尚达人啦！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I got the Hair Brush.
...but it makes me sad.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我拿到了(时装)红发梳。
...但这让我感到难过。

scripts.text:
[Hat Girl]
Huh? Don't you want to be
the best fashionista?
You don't have enough materials?
scripts.translation:
[戴帽子的女孩]
咦？你不想成为最棒的时尚达人吗？
材料不够吗？

scripts.text:
[Hat Girl]
To make the latest style ^0000FFHair Brush^000000,
I need ^0000FF1 Mixture, 1 Scarlet Dyestuffs,
50 Solid Shells, 5 Eluniums,^000000
also 1 ^0000FFAxe^000000 with 4 sockets on it.
scripts.translation:
[戴帽子的女孩]
要制作最新款的^0000FF(时装)红发梳^000000，
我需要^0000FF1个混合剂、1个红色染料、
50个坚硬外皮、5个铝，^000000
还需要1把带有4个孔的^0000FF斧头^000000。

scripts.text:
[Hat Girl]
What are you doing? Hurry!
scripts.translation:
[戴帽子的女孩]
你在干什么？快点！

scripts.text:
[Hat Girl]
Here is one tip for you.
You can easily get Solid Shells and Elunium from the monsters.
scripts.translation:
[戴帽子的女孩]
给你一个小提示。
你可以很容易地从魔物身上获得坚硬外皮和铝。

scripts.text:
[Hat Girl]
You're carrying too much stuff.
Come again after emptying your bag.
scripts.translation:
[戴帽子的女孩]
你携带的物品太多了。
清空背包后再来吧。

scripts.text:
- Wait !! -
- You have too many items, so it's -
- impossible to have more. -
- Come to me again -
- after emptying some of it. -
scripts.translation:
- 等等！！ -
- 你的物品太多了，所以 -
- 不可能再装更多了。 -
- 清空一些物品后 -
- 再来找我。 -

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
A fake angel? Go away!
scripts.translation:
[贝贝特]
假天使？走开！

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
The real angel
is not as weak as you.
scripts.translation:
[贝贝特]
真正的神天使
不像你这么弱。

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
Oh, the angel came again.
Are you quite satisfied with ^FF0000Statue Of Baby Angel^000000, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[贝贝特]
哦，天使又来了。
你对^FF0000小天使雕像^000000还满意吧？

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
Ah! Hey, angel~ angel~
scripts.translation:
[贝贝特]
啊！嘿，天使~天使~

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
Please show me the Statue of Baby Angel!
I heard every angel has it!
scripts.translation:
[贝贝特]
请给我看看小天使雕像！
我听说每个天使都有！

scripts.text: Statue of Baby Angel?
scripts.translation: 小天使雕像？

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
Did you lose it?
Do you want me to make it for you?
scripts.translation:
[贝贝特]
你弄丢了？
你想让我给你做一个吗？

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text: Yes, I want it now.
scripts.translation: 是的，我现在就要。

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
Oh... it's not easy to make a living!
scripts.translation:
[贝贝特]
唉...生活真不容易啊！

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
Wow, you already know all the materials, angel.
scripts.translation:
[贝贝特]
哇，天使，你已经知道所有材料了。

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
You're lucky. I have one statue on going.
So you don't need to wait for long.
scripts.translation:
[贝贝特]
你很幸运。我正好有一个雕像在做。
所以你不用等太久。

scripts.text: I got the ^FF0000Statue of Baby Angel^000000.
scripts.translation: 我拿到了^FF0000小天使雕像^000000。

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
See you again, my angel~!
scripts.translation:
[贝贝特]
再见了，我的天使~！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm... I guess I was fooled by that little kid.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...看来我被那个小孩子骗了。

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
Hey, I don't see
any materials in your bag..
scripts.translation:
[贝贝特]
嘿，我好像没看到
你背包里有材料...

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
Hey, angel...
scripts.translation:
[贝贝特]
嘿，天使...

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
Wow, the angel!
scripts.translation:
[贝贝特]
哇，是天使！

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
Are you a real angel? Have you been to heaven?
scripts.translation:
[贝贝特]
你是真正的天使吗？你去过天堂吗？

scripts.text: What bullshit!
scripts.translation: 胡说八道！

scripts.text: Let's keep the childhood innocence!
scripts.translation: 让我们保持童心吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Angel and heaven? It's all made up!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
天使和天堂？那都是编出来的！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There's nothing. Everything is lie!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什么都没有。一切都是谎言！

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
You're a devil! a monster! an idiot!
scripts.translation:
[贝贝特]
你是恶魔！是魔物！是个笨蛋！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course. I used to dance with the dragon and zebra
on the vanilla-taste clouds.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
当然。我曾经和龙还有斑马
在香草味的云朵上跳舞。

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
That's just what I've been imagining!
scripts.translation:
[贝贝特]
那只是我想象出来的！

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
Please show me the Statue of Baby Angel!
I heard every angel has it!
scripts.translation:
[贝贝特]
请给我看看小天使雕像！
我听说每个天使都有！

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
Oops, did you lose it?
Do you want me to make one for you?
scripts.translation:
[贝贝特]
哎呀，你弄丢了？
你想让我给你做一个吗？

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
I made it several times before
for the angels like you.
scripts.translation:
[贝贝特]
我之前已经给像你这样的天使
做过好几次了。

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
I can make it with ^FF0000500 Feather Of Birds, 1 Holy Water, 10 Muscovite, 1 Heaven Ring and 1 Shining Stone^000000.
scripts.translation:
[贝贝特]
我可以用^FF0000500个鸟羽、1个圣水、10个云母、1个天堂戒指和1个闪烁之石^000000来做。

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
Okay, hurry!
scripts.translation:
[贝贝特]
好的，快点！

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
A fake angel? Go away!!
scripts.translation:
[贝贝特]
假天使？走开！！

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
The real angel has
the wings on the head!
scripts.translation:
[贝贝特]
真正的天使
翅膀是在头上的！

scripts.text:
[Bebete]
What are you carrying that much, angel?
I can't give you the item
because your bag is too full.
scripts.translation:
[贝贝特]
天使，你带了这么多东西？
因为你的背包太满了，
所以我无法把物品给你。

scripts.text:
- Wait !! -
- You have too many items, so it's -
- impossible to have more. -
- Come to me again -
- after emptying some of it. -
scripts.translation:
- 等等！！ -
- 你的物品太多了，所以 -
- 不可能再装更多了。 -
- 清空一些物品后 -
- 再来找我。 -

scripts.text:
[???]
Hmm..Hm..
It seems my transformation into the child's appearance is successful.
scripts.translation:
[???]
嗯...嗯...
看来我变成小孩子外表的伪装很成功。

scripts.text:
[???]
Human! I am here to ask you some help.
scripts.translation:
[???]
人类！我来这里是想请你帮个忙。

scripts.text:
[???]
I am the great King Froggie VII!
scripts.translation:
[???]
我是伟大的青蛙王七世！

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
but I think you're not strong enough to help us.
Go and train more!
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
但我觉得你还不够强，帮不了我们。
去多训练一下吧！

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
Over lvl 65 human will be fine for us.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
65级以上的人类对我们来说就足够了。

scripts.text:
[???]
I am the great king, Froggie VII..
I need your help!
scripts.translation:
[???]
我是伟大的国王，青蛙七世。
我需要你的帮助！

scripts.text: Just ignore it.
scripts.translation: 直接无视

scripts.text: Let's help him.
scripts.translation: 帮他一把

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Talking frog...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
会说话的青蛙...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now I've seen everything.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
真是见多识广了。

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
Croaking...Croaking...
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
呱呱...呱呱...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
有什么我可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
Our great frog race is now endangered because many travellers came here and take our eggs as a kind of souvenirs. I even heard there are many left on the ground here and there, so I need your help. Please bring back ^FF0000100 Spawn^000000.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
我们伟大的青蛙一族现在正处于危险之中，因为许多旅行者来到这里，把我们的蛋当作纪念品带走。我甚至听说地上到处都散落着蛋，所以我需要你的帮助。请带回^FF0000100个蛙卵^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sure, I will.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没问题，我会的。

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
I will be waiting for you!
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
我会等着你的！

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
What are you doing here?
Go and get ^FF0000100 Spawn^000000!
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
你在这里做什么？
快去收集^FF0000100个蛙卵^000000！

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
Oh, you brought all of them!
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
哦，你都带回来了！

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
Thank you so much, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
非常感谢你，{0}。

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
By the way, we have another urgent matter. So I would ask you one more help.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
顺便说一下，我们还有另一件紧急的事情。所以我想再请你帮个忙。

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
Frogs are healthy food to the snakes.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
对蛇来说，青蛙是健康的食物。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I know well.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我当然知道。

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
Well, that's good. Aren't you feel sorry for our race?
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
很好。难道你不觉得我们的种族很可怜吗？

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
So, I hereby ask you to take revenge on them. Kill ^FF000050 Side Winders^000000 for us.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
所以，我在此请求你替我们复仇。为我们击杀^FF000050只黑蛇^000000。

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
I'll be waiting for your news!
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
我会等待你的好消息！

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
I'm waiting for your good news.
It would be a piece of cake for you
to kill ^FF000050 Side Winders^000000. Keep it up!
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
我在等待你的好消息。
击杀^FF000050只黑蛇^000000对你来说是小菜一碟。加油！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm back.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我回来了。

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
You seemingly killed all the Side Winders!
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
看来你已经杀光了所有的黑蛇！

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
You became an example for the young frogs. Thank you again.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
你成为了年轻青蛙们的榜样。再次感谢你。

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
Therefore, I'm considering adding your outstanding exploit to our frog's history book. But I need your evidence for your work.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
因此，我考虑将你的卓越功绩载入青蛙史书。但我需要你的工作证据。

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
Please bring me ^FF0000 100 ^000000 ^FF0000Venom Canines^000000 from the snakes.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
请从蛇那里带回^FF0000100个^000000^FF0000毒牙^000000给我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm happy to be added in the history book. I'll go and get them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我很高兴能载入史书。我会去收集它们的。

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
Obedient, hard-working... I hope I have a loyal frog like you.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
听话、勤劳...我希望我也能拥有像你这样忠诚的青蛙。

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
How about ^FF0000100 Venom Canines^000000?
Hurry, it's a rare opportunity to be added in the frog history book!
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
^FF0000100个毒牙^000000怎么样？
快点，这是载入青蛙史书的难得机会！

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
Oh, you brought Venom Canines! Now, I'm able to put you in the frog history book officially.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
哦，你带回了毒牙！现在，我可以正式将你载入青蛙史书了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's good for me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这对我来说是好事。

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
I have a better news!
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
我有个更好的消息！

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
I found a great method to keep our race while I was looking up the history book!
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
我在查阅史书时，发现了一个保护我们种族的好方法！

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
The answer was in the frog history book. In the old days, the great King Froggie III made a secret medicine enabling us to use a hiding skill from the snakes.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
答案就在青蛙史书中。在古代，伟大的青蛙王三世发明了一种秘药，让我们能够使用隐匿技能来躲避蛇。

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
I should have known this earlier...
Please get me ^FF000050 Scaled Shells^000000.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
我本该早点知道这一点的...
请帮我收集^FF000050个鳞片^000000。

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
It's not easy to get, but I'm sure you can do it.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
这并不容易，但我相信你能做到。

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
Still here? Go and get ^FF000050 Scaled Shells^000000! Please hurry!
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
还在这里？快去收集^FF000050个鳞片^000000！请快点！

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
Excellent!
You're like the great King Froggie III in his young days!
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
太棒了！
你就像年轻时的青蛙王三世一样！

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
You are already the hero for our frogs! If I have a child, I would marry you up with my child.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
你已经是青蛙们的英雄了！如果我有个孩子，我会把你许配给我的孩子。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah... No, thanks.
^FF0000(Are you telling me to marry a frog???)^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊...不，谢谢。
^FF0000(你是在让我嫁给一只青蛙吗？？？)^000000

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
Thanks to you, the population of frog has increased but we're short of food.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
多亏了你，青蛙的数量增加了，但我们的食物不够了。

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
The best food for us is ^FF0000Argiope^000000.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
对我们来说，最好的食物是^FF0000艾吉欧蜈蚣^000000。

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
Now, what are you doing, our hero?
Go and get ^FF000050 Argiopes^000000!
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
现在，我们的英雄，你在做什么？
快去收集^FF000050只艾吉欧蜈蚣^000000！

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
My hero, are you going to starve us to death?
Go and bring us ^FF000050 Argiopes^000000!
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
我的英雄，你难道要让我们饿死吗？
快去给我们带^FF000050只艾吉欧蜈蚣^000000来！

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
I think I saw you a while ago, but now you became the hero for the frogs...
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
我好像不久前见过你，但现在你成了青蛙们的英雄...

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
It was really lucky for me to ask you a favor.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
真幸运，我向你提出了这个请求。

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
I'd like to give you a reward, our hero. But your bag is now too heavy.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
我想给你一些奖励，我们的英雄。但你的背包现在太重了。

scripts.text:
- Wait !! -
- You have too many items, so it's -
- impossible to have more. -
- Come to me again -
- after emptying some of it. -
scripts.translation:
- 等等！！ -
- 你的物品太多了，所以 -
- 不可能再装更多了。 -
- 清空一些物品后 -
- 再来找我。 -

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
Frogs, do you have any objection
to give our hero, {0}
a Frog Hat which is one of our precious treasures?
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
青蛙们，你们有没有意见
把我们的珍贵宝物之一——青蛙帽
送给我们的英雄{0}？

scripts.text:
[Sounds from somewhere]
Croak...croak...
croooooaaaaak~~~
Croak croak
scripts.translation:
[不知从何处传来的声响]
呱...呱...
呱~~~~~~
呱呱

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
Hmm, there is no objection.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
嗯，没有意见。

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
I hereby give {0}, our hero, this Frog Hat.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
我在此将青蛙帽授予我们的英雄{0}。

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
You are always welcome.
Visit here at any time.
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
随时欢迎。
请随时来这里。

scripts.text:
[King Froggie VII]
All the frogs in the world, praise {0}, our eternal hero!
scripts.translation:
[青蛙王七世]
全世界的青蛙们，赞美我们永恒的英雄{0}！

scripts.text: There is a frog. What should I do?
scripts.translation: 有一只青蛙。我该怎么做？

scripts.text: Throw it a stone.
scripts.translation: 扔石头

scripts.text: Have a conversation.
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text: Ouch~
scripts.translation: 哎哟~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's so amazing to see
the frog which transforms itself.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看到青蛙变身的样子，真是太神奇了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh my.. the frog transformed into a child...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
天哪...这只青蛙竟然变成了小孩...

scripts.text:
[Alonie]
I am an expert at playing alone.
I'm trying my best to play alone!
scripts.translation:
[阿洛妮]
我是独自玩耍的专家。
我正在努力练习独自玩耍！

scripts.text:
[Alonie]
HuHu, Yapyap!
I can feel your admiration for me.
Wanna be my student?
scripts.translation:
[阿洛妮]
呼呼，呀呀！
我能感觉到你对我的崇拜。
想拜我为师吗？

scripts.text: You're out of your mind!
scripts.translation: 你疯了吧！

scripts.text: Please let me be your disciple!
scripts.translation: 请让我拜您为师！

scripts.text:
[Alonie]
Yes, I'm out of my mind.
Huhu, Yapyap!
scripts.translation:
[阿洛妮]
是的，我疯了。
呼呼，呀呀！

scripts.text:
[Alonie]
I can feel you are lack of affection. Okay!
Now, let's start the training!
scripts.translation:
[阿洛妮]
我能感觉到你很缺乏关爱。好吧！
现在，让我们开始训练吧！

scripts.text:
[Alonie]
The special training, to play alone in Sphinx Dungeon!
For make it
the fruitful training,
Get around and kill
^FF000020 Zeroms, 20 Requiems^000000!
Hurry!
scripts.translation:
[阿洛妮]
特殊训练：在斯芬克斯地下城独自玩耍！
为了让训练更有成效，
去那里击杀
^FF000020只杰洛米和20只诺可伊^000000！
快去吧！

scripts.text: What bullshit!
scripts.translation: 胡说八道！

scripts.text: Let's go!
scripts.translation: 出发吧！

scripts.text:
[Alonie]
Of course, I don't care.
Huhu, Yapyap!
scripts.translation:
[阿洛妮]
当然，我不在乎。
呼呼，呀呀！

scripts.text:
[Alonie]
Hurry up, my student.
I am so capricious
so I don't know what I will
give you as a reward!
scripts.translation:
[阿洛妮]
快点，我的学生。
我心情多变，
所以我不知道会给你什么奖励！

scripts.text:
[Alonie]
Already finished?
Good, here is the next training

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
